title: Share of a Held Installment Released After a Death, by Payout Basis — Income Annuities
content:
How much of an installment held in suspense on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract for a payment date after a death is released depends on the payout basis of the tier:

- **Joint and survivor, contract continuing to the survivor.** On a joint-and-survivor tier whose contract status is survivor continuing, the survivor share of an installment held for a payment date after the first death is the tier's survivor continuation percentage of the joint installment of that payment date, rounded to the cent and never more than the held installment.
- **Life only or cash refund.** On the Life Only or Cash Refund tier, nothing of an installment held for a payment date after the death is released.
- Where neither describes the held installment, neither rule applies.

The part not released is forfeited back to the contract. "After the death" means a payment date later than the death date recorded on the contract.

### Cases (hypothetical; first death 10 May; installment held for 1 June)

| Tier, status | Held installment | Joint installment of 1 June | Released | Forfeited |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Joint 50% Survivor, survivor continuing | $2,000.00 | $2,000.00 | $1,000.00 | $1,000.00 |
| Joint 100% Survivor, survivor continuing | $2,000.00 | $2,060.00 | $2,000.00 (never more than the held installment) | $0.00 |
| Life Only | $2,000.00 | — | $0.00 | $2,000.00 |
| Cash Refund, installment held for 1 May (before the death) | $2,000.00 | — | Neither rule applies | — |
